_doc: Maskinläsbara stilvärden. Förklaringar i docs/style-guide.md. Alla verktyg läser härifrån.

prompt.house_style: stylized semi-realistic game art, hand-painted PBR look, painterly brush strokes, low-frequency detail, large calm color areas, soft top-down light-to-dark gradient, subtle lighter edge highlights, saturated but controlled colors, warm light and cool shadows, chunky readable shapes

kinds.tile: seamless tileable texture, flat orthographic view filling the entire frame, even diffuse lighting, no cast shadows, no perspective
kinds.cutout: isolated on a pure flat white background, no shadow, no ground

prompt.surface_view: orthographic top-down view looking straight down at the ground like a drone photo pointed straight down, everything seen from directly above as flat shapes, no side view, no horizon, no perspective, no depth of field
prompt.surface_style: stylized hand-painted game texture, painterly brush strokes, low-frequency detail, large calm color areas, saturated but controlled colors, even flat lighting
prompt.character_art: Stylized fantasy character key art, polished game concept art, premium fantasy splash art, painterly box-art illustration, semi-realism, bold clean shapes, clean readable silhouette, elegant exaggerated proportions, appealing stylized face, smooth painterly rendering with no line art and no outlines, crisp edges and soft gradients, dramatic cinematic lighting with strong rim light, muted base colors with one rich saturated accent, glossy metal and leather with broad highlights, detailed fabrics, expressive environment, atmospheric depth, premium game promotional artwork, no text.
prompt._character_doc: Konceptbilder av karaktärer: motivet först, sedan character_art, sist character_remove. Krea-2 kör cfg 1 och ignorerar negativa prompter; krea2.py använder Krea2PromptWeight när prompten har (ord:vikt). Nämn aldrig befintliga spel eller studior.

character._doc: Bildstilen (prompt.character_art) översatt till 3D. Förklaring i docs/style-guide.md avsnitt 6.

colors._doc: RGB 0–1. Kroma = max − min (HSV-mättnad överdriver mörka toner). Basfärger (cloth, pants, shoes) dämpade; exakt en accentregion per karaktär. Hår och hud är fria.

stylize._doc: Procedurtargets på hm08 mot konceptstilen (hm08.mjs stylizeRaw). 1 = oförändrat; blandas mellan female och male efter gender.

face._doc: Ansiktsförval som MakeHuman-targets (third_party/makehuman/targets, utan .target.gz) med vikter; {s} blir l och r. Blandas mellan female och male efter gender; recipe.face lägger till eller överstyr.
